description: Implementation of WebSocket HTTP/2 handshake stream handling, including request initialization, sending, response processing, and upgrade to WebSocket stream.

classes.name: WebSocketHttp2HandshakeStream
classes.description: Handles WebSocket handshake over HTTP/2, including request sending, response validation, and stream upgrade.

methods.name: RegisterRequest
methods.description: Registers the HTTP request info for the handshake.

methods.name: InitializeStream
methods.description: Initializes the stream with priority and logging.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends the WebSocket handshake request over HTTP/2.

methods.name: ReadResponseHeaders
methods.description: Reads response headers from the server.

methods.name: ReadResponseBody
methods.description: Not implemented; callers should upgrade to WebSocketStream.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the stream and cleans up resources.

methods.name: IsResponseBodyComplete
methods.description: Indicates if response body is complete.

methods.name: IsConnectionReused
methods.description: Indicates if the connection is reused.

methods.name: SetConnectionReused
methods.description: Marks the connection as reused.

methods.name: CanReuseConnection
methods.description: Indicates if the connection can be reused.

methods.name: GetTotalReceivedBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes received.

methods.name: GetTotalSentBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes sent.

methods.name: GetAlternativeService
methods.description: Retrieves alternative service info.

methods.name: GetLoadTimingInfo
methods.description: Gets load timing information.

methods.name: GetSSLInfo
methods.description: Retrieves SSL information.

methods.name: GetSSLCertRequestInfo
methods.description: Not supported; should not request client certificates on multiplexed stream.

methods.name: GetRemoteEndpoint
methods.description: Gets remote endpoint address.

methods.name: PopulateNetErrorDetails
methods.description: Populates network error details.

methods.name: Drain
methods.description: Drains the session, closing the stream.

methods.name: SetPriority
methods.description: Sets the request priority.

methods.name: RenewStreamForAuth
methods.description: Renewal of stream for authentication is not supported.

methods.name: GetDnsAliases
methods.description: Returns DNS aliases for the session.

methods.name: GetAcceptChViaAlps
methods.description: Returns ALPS accept channel info.

methods.name: Upgrade
methods.description: Upgrades the HTTP/2 stream to a WebSocketStream, possibly with deflate extension.

methods.name: CanReadFromStream
methods.description: Checks if stream adapter is initialized for reading.

methods.name: GetWeakPtr
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the handshake stream.

methods.name: OnHeadersSent
methods.description: Callback when headers are sent.

methods.name: OnHeadersReceived
methods.description: Handles received response headers and validates response.

methods.name: OnClose
methods.description: Handles stream closure and errors.

methods.name: StartRequestCallback
methods.description: Callback after starting request, handles stream setup.

methods.name: ValidateResponse
methods.description: Validates the server response code and headers.

methods.name: ValidateUpgradeResponse
methods.description: Validates the upgrade response headers for WebSocket handshake.

methods.name: OnFailure
methods.description: Handles failure scenarios, reporting errors.
